P01.rationale: There are no human portraits or people visible anywhere on this page.

P05.rationale: The page contains only text blocks and a statistic; there are no client case studies or portraits.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as logos, ratings, or testimonials present on the page.

P10.rationale: The typography consists of standard body text and headers without any oversized decorative elements like ghost numerals.

P11.rationale: A specific data point (50%) is highlighted in a large typographic element, though it lacks a full chart or visualisation frame.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and horizontal dividers.

P13.rationale: The background is completely flat blankness (off-white) without any intentional texture or atmosphere.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (phone/laptop) are shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The imagery is non-existent, so it cannot be generic stock; the design relies entirely on typography.

N08.rationale: There are no large empty regions with dead whitespace; the text blocks fill most of the available space.

N10.rationale: Since there is no imagery on this page, there is no risk of text sitting on a busy photo or awkward inset gaps.
